Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Earns Market Perform Rating from Raymond James Financial Posted by Paula Ricardo | Feb 24th, 2018 
Raymond James Financial restated their market perform rating on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a report issued on Friday, February 16th, Marketbeat Ratings reports. 
Other equities analysts have also recently issued research reports about the company. Zacks Investment Research cut Apple from a buy rating to a hold rating in a report on Friday, January 19th. Mizuho restated a neutral rating and set a $175.00 price objective (up previously from $160.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, January 19th. Barclays set a $174.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a neutral rating in a report on Thursday, January 18th. Bank of America cut Apple from a buy rating to a neutral rating and boosted their price objective for the stock from $180.00 to $220.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 17th. Finally, Atlantic Securities downgraded shares of Apple from an overweight rating to a neutral rating and lifted their price target for the company from $177.35 to $190.00 in a research report on Monday, January 22nd. They noted that the move was a valuation call. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have assigned a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. The company presently has a consensus rating of Buy and a consensus target price of $201.64. Get Apple alerts: 
Shares of Apple ( AAPL ) traded up $3.00 during trading on Friday, reaching $175.50. The company had a trading volume of 33,758,387 shares, compared to its average volume of 43,190,000. Apple has a twelve month low of $135.28 and a twelve month high of $180.10. The firm has a market cap of $905,980.00, a P/E ratio of 17.17, a PEG ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 1.33. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $3.36 EPS. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. equities research analysts predict that Apple will post 11.43 EPS for the current fiscal year. 
The company also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th were paid a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.44%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is 24.66%. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Thursday, December 7th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.69, for a total value of $2,654,121.29. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 17,341 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,942,594.29. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available at this link . Also, insider Eduardo H. Cue sold 65,361 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Thursday, November 30th. The shares were sold at an average price of $171.60, for a total transaction of $11,215,947.60. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last quarter, insiders sold 96,643 shares of company stock valued at $16,603,803. Company insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.

Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,003,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,880,992,000 after buying an additional 15,018,790 shares during the period. Harbour Capital Advisors LLC now owns 4,515,315 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $31,352,000 after buying an additional 4,483,360 shares during the period. Amundi Pioneer Asset Management Inc. boosted its holdings in Apple by 50.7% in the 4th quarter. Amundi Pioneer Asset Management Inc. now owns 13,228,306 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,238,624,000 after buying an additional 4,448,509 shares during the period. Truepoint Inc. boosted its holdings in Apple by 15,559.4% in the 3rd quarter. Truepoint Inc. now owns 4,436,774 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,437,000 after buying an additional 4,408,441 shares during the period. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,241,383,000 after buying an additional 3,845,363 shares during the period. 59.70% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
